scope: The resume available to public site visitors and the governed lifecycle of every opportunity on the hiring radar
readerProblem: The public resume was an OTI application artifact. It could be strong for one submitted role while making other active hiring readers infer engineering delivery, enterprise project implementation, or product-operations fit, and it did not fail closed when a thematically adjacent role carried an unmet hard screen.

baseline.note: The baseline records a missing universal-resume governance mechanism, not a retroactive judgment that the OTI application resume was poor.

iterations.boundedChange: Defined the exact active truthfully-hirable set as CodePath Engineering Project Manager, ACLU Senior Project Manager, Benepass Product Operations Manager, and the submitted-pending OTI Senior Product Manager role; retained the expired OTI Operations role as a benchmark and excluded the open Studio3 postdoc through two unmet Architecture degree screens.
iterations.result: Affinity, application status, expiration, and formal eligibility are separate states; a hard-screened role remains discoverable without shaping the public resume.

iterations.boundedChange: Created one ATS-readable public Markdown resume emphasizing technical project management, product operations, engineering delivery, systems implementation, resident services, responsible delivery, and bounded collective-credit evidence across the four active opportunities.
iterations.result: The 786-word artifact passes all seven isolated fictionalized public-source reader/opportunity screens while preserving truth, role boundaries, and public safety.

iterations.boundedChange: Applied the established read-only Google Docs style system in a private copy, preserved all ten required public/contact destinations, exported a two-page tagged US Letter PDF, and made the maintained sibling byte-identical to the public site install.
iterations.result: The sixth maintained PDF artifact passes structure, link, artifact-binding, read-only-source, and page-by-page visual gates.

iterations.boundedChange: Replaced an orphaned NYC Artist Coalition bullet at the top of page two with a deliberate role boundary: page one closes after the complete Thick Arts LLC block and page two opens with the complete coalition block.
iterations.result: Both pages remain legible and unclipped, and every experience story keeps its heading, dates, and evidence together.

iterations.boundedChange: Restored the exact approved CallNYC.org follow-on wording in the authoritative Markdown and native-layout PDF after the first universal draft made the project name implicit in the section heading.
iterations.result: The broader multi-opportunity argument retains the governed civic-product proof, and public-safety, text-layer, link, and visual checks can all evaluate the same two-page artifact.

boundary: These are deterministic, fictionalized public-source resume screens. No named person participated, endorsed Jamie, promised an interview, resolved formal eligibility, or made a hiring decision.
